old_findings.note: 57 -> 51 whiles: the abi.encode copies of the action strings/bytes in cancel, execute and getActionsSetById are now copy lines. The storage copies of string[]/bytes[] in processMessageFromRoot (_queue) remain nested loops.

regressions.old: if isActionQueued[concat(mem[0])]: revert with 0xecbc138c  |  mem[_358 + 32] = 32 * mem[128] + 224
regressions.issue: The DuplicateAction custom error, clean in the old text, is a raw memory revert again: the base variables _86 and _105 (two loads of mem[64]) are not unified. For the same reason the action hash reads its first field as mem[_105 + 32] (repeated 4 times), and the ActionsSetQueued encoding prints '_358 + 32 * _359 - mem[64] + 224' where '32 * mem[128] + 224' was shown.
regressions.rule: Two loads of slot 0x40 with no store that can reach it between them read the same value (stores at mem[64] + k, k >= 32, cannot, given the floor >= 0x80); unify them before resolving revert data, keccak inputs and offsets.

new_findings.source: abi.encode(target, value, signature, data, executionTime, withDelegatecall) (two dynamic fields in a row)
new_findings.issue: ceil32(_53) + ceil32(_53) is printed as 2 * Mask(250, 5, _53 + 31), next to plain ceil32(_53) in the same lines.
new_findings.rule: Print k * floor32(x + 31) as k * ceil32(x); do not turn a doubled multiple of 32 into a bit mask.

improvements: Custom errors and messages resolved (InsufficientBalance(), 0xcbd8fb4c), concat(mem[0]) keys 3 -> 0: the actionHash is now decoded as the keccak of the ABI encoding. Returns: executeDelegateCall returns Array(len, data); getActionsSetById's return is split into its head words and arrays instead of 'return memory'. The call in execute shows Array(len, data) arguments. Fields named (stor6[proposalId].field_256... instead of stor[_ + 1]).
notes: Diff (1,073 lines) read hunk by hunk; processMessageFromRoot (597-line diff) by structure, after filtering renames of loop variables (idx/s/t...) and temporaries. Loops all present (3 source loops); whiles 57 -> 51, all removed ones implicit copies. The changed functions grew 9% in characters (lines over 240 chars 3 -> 10), mainly from the decoded hashes and returns. The execute result-handling branch was restructured equivalently (store and continue on success, revert otherwise).
summary: Mostly improvements (copy lines, decoded hashes, errors and returns). One medium regression: the DuplicateAction custom error in _queue is raw memory again (two mem[64] loads not unified), which also leaves the hash and encoding offsets partly raw. A new 2 * Mask(250, 5, x + 31) display artifact.
